in_marathi.name: Madhusudan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sweet or nectar-filled one
in_marathi.long_meaning: Madhusudan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Madhu means nectar or sweet, and sudan means one who subdues or calms. This name is given to a child believed to have the ability to soothe and pacify others with their sweet nature.

vedic_reference.note: This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'madhu' meaning 'honey' and 'sudan' meaning 'one who gives'. It is the name of Lord Vishnu in his form as the slayer of the demon Madhu. He is also known as Madhava and Matsya Avatar. The name is mentioned in various Hindu scriptures including the Mahabharata and the Bhagavad Gita.
